best_idea: When a respawn is requested for a place that is not loaded yet, hold it in a pending list, widen the load area while it waits, and release it on each update once the place is ready.
decision_why: The wait-for-zone gate fits zones as data, but Frankendom has no chunk streaming yet, so keep the gate and the per-zone watch radius and drop the view-distance widening until zones stream.
acceptance: A server test kills a hero in an unloaded zone and asserts no placement with the death screen up; after the zone is marked loaded the hero is placed within one server tick and the queue is empty; a disconnected queued hero leaves no queue entry.
